source.name: Equiti: Equiti signs as founding partner of Dubai Basketball ahead of EuroLeague debut
source.quote: Equiti will feature prominently on official jerseys and courtside at the Coca-Cola Arena
source.note: equiti.com blocks scripts; read in the Wayback Machine copy of 22 January 2026 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260122005347/https://www.equiti.com/sc-en/media-room/media-releases/equiti-signs-as-founding-partner-of-dubai-basketball-ahead-of-euroleague-debut/).

note: Founding Partner and Official Digital Wealth Partner 'for the next three seasons' from September 2025; the Equiti logo is on the back of the 2026/27 home jersey (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0765/6806/8250/files/DSC05168.jpg).
